item.title: Cheap long life houses
item.description:
The only inexpensive 3-story that will actually last 300 years around Bengaluru or Tirupati is a thick load-bearing stone box with lime-surkhi mortar and a pitched tile roof, not a modern cement RCC frame box.

Modern RCC framed houses are designed for 50-70 years because the steel inside the concrete rusts when water gets in. The houses that have already lasted 300 years in India are all the same: stone or burnt brick, lime mortar, thick breathable walls, and a roof that throws water far away from the walls.

item.title: Leak proofing concrete
item.description:
That waterproof liquid mixed into the concrete helps a lot, but by itself it will NOT give you a 300-year flat roof - it will give you a 50+ year slab that still needs a membrane and tiles on top.

What they sell here as “waterproof liquid” is an integral admixture. The common one you see on Bengaluru sites is Dr Fixit Pidiproof LW+.

What it actually is

It’s not magic waterproof paint. It is a specially formulated integral liquid waterproofing compound composed of surface-active plasticizing agents, polymers and additives. It improves workability of freshly mixed concrete and improves waterproofing of concrete. Dose is 200 ml per 50 kg bag of cement.
